subject: Next steps: procurement & PO vs card for Orion Finance
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orionfin.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:00:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (procurement)

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can get Redwood set up in your vendor system and confirm commercial path: 

- Procurement readiness: You mentioned vendor setup and a standard vendor packet.
- Commercial path: Orion prefers POs where possible; card is OK for initial pilots under $5k.
- Questions outstanding: W-9 vs W-8, banking details, expected timeline for vendor setup.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send our standard vendor packet and stub W-9 (attached).
2) If procurement needs anything else (insurance, bank ACH form), please send specifics or portal link.
3) Marissa on our procurement team will be your primary contact for vendor setup — looping her in.

If PO is the path, can you share the typical PO terms (lead time, net terms) and any required AP contact?

Thanks —
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[dylan_brooks@redwood.com]

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (stub)

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orionfin.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orionfin.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (procurement)

Thanks, Dylan —

Helpful recap. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We need a completed vendor packet with W-9 (we're US-based). W-9 is required for new vendors.
- Banking details: our AP team needs bank name, routing, account number, plus a voided check or bank letter. We can accept a stub for intake but will require full docs before first payment.
- PO vs card: Our standard is PO for contracts > $2,500. Card spend is allowed for one-off purchases under that threshold. For platform subscriptions, we generally issue POs.
- Timeline: vendor setup typically takes 7–10 business days after we receive all docs.

Can you have your procurement contact send the completed packet to procurement@orionfin.com? Also, do you support marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) — that would simplify procurement for us.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of Procurement, Orion Finance

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orionfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 12:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (procurement)

Thanks Samantha — great, that helps. Quick notes: 

- We can provide an official W-9 and vendor packet today — attaching stubs here for intake. Full banking details we'll provide to your AP team via secure channel (we typically send bank forms through our procurement portal or via encrypted email).
- We support PO billing and can invoice on your PO with Net30 unless you need a different term.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed in AWS Marketplace for some customers — I’ll check whether the specific subscription type you want is available there and confirm. If marketplace billing is acceptable to you, that often speeds procurement.

Marissa — can you take point on sending the completed vendor packet and coordinate secure delivery of banking details? Samantha — the procurement portal link is included below if you want to upload directly.

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachments: Orion_vendor_setup_packet.pdf, W-9_OrionFinance.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orionfin.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup packet & secure banking delivery

Hi Samantha —

Looping in from Redwood procurement. Attached is our vendor setup packet and W-9 (PDFs). For banking details, our process is: 

1) We upload bank info to our secure procurement portal (link below) and invite your AP contact to a one-time access link.
2) Alternatively, we can send an encrypted email with the bank letter and a voided check.

Please confirm your AP contact name and email so we can push the secure invite. Also attaching a short checklist of required items to avoid delays (insurance, W-9, banking doc).

Estimated vendor setup timeline once we have all docs: 5–7 business days. If you need a faster path for an initial pilot under $5k, we can accept card payment and start immediately while vendor onboarding completes.

Checklist (attached): vendor_packet.pdf, W-9, bank_letter/voided_check, certificate_of_insurance (if required).

Links: https://redwood.app/procurement/portal/ORN-2026-042

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Orion_vendor_setup_packet.pdf, W-9_OrionFinance.pdf, bank_details_stub.txt

From: Ben Harper <ben.harper@orionfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@orionfin.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 17:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor setup packet & secure banking delivery

Marissa — thanks for the packet. AP contact is myself (Ben Harper) — ben.harper@orionfin.com. Please send the secure invite and I’ll upload the bank letter and voided check.

We plan to route this as a PO (since this will be an ongoing platform subscription) — ETA for PO issuance is ~7 business days after vendor onboarding. If you can kick off the onboarding today, we can align timelines.

Also: AWS Marketplace would be preferred if available — please confirm whether Redwood can be procured there for the subscription SKU we discussed.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Manager, Finance Ops, Orion Finance
